API_gap_overlap.scope: CUPTI timestamps measure kernel gaps and temporal API overlap. API duration is host time. It is not added to GPU time. A gap outside an API can include host preparation or stream waits. Its cause is not identified by subtraction. Only v3 captures with the explicit API-export collector support this analysis.
